actual_scope: All-size cumulative destination-supported leaf-defect transport to the completed endpoint of the unchanged PR628 reserved-depth balanced word, both orientations; exact response counts and conditional rounded-leaf budget.
scope_change_reason: The card permits a precision lemma. This isolates the completed endpoint, not arbitrary intermediate cuts, and simultaneous errors rather than PR1855's finite single-error census.
bottleneck_link: A sharper endpoint execution-error inequality can improve a sufficient local precision budget without dropping the interior feedback, source restoration, preparation or tape premises; no selected supplier or kappa change.
stop_rule: Completed one all-size endpoint interface: direct four-phase proof, exact all-row recurrence and bounded source-bound evidence. No supplier word, production precision reserve or paid call count is changed.
evidence: README contains the all-size proof T(n)=T(floor(n/2))+2T(ceil(n/2)), exact scratch counts, independent-defect attainment and a conditional endpoint-only precision substitution. RESULT.json and the registered verifier bind both orientations on the stated finite source domain; test_verify.py checks independent forward responses and semantic failure controls.
author: Adam Gall (@adamgall), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: OpenAI Codex performed source research, mathematical derivation, implementation and writing. No subagents or independent human review.
object: Balanced four-phase dirty commutator U,V,U^-1,V^-1, floor/ceiling split, one disjoint connector per depth shared by siblings
changed_premise: All destination-supported errors, completed endpoint only; not a larger finite interval domain
method_domain: All n>=1 and normed-space operators with ordered-subset product bound G>=1. Finite exact free-algebra and scalar evidence on a declared bounded domain; no extrapolation from tests.
optimistic_full_cost_budget: No calls are removed: N(n)=3qn-2q^2 for q=2^floor(log2 n); h=ceil(log2 n) dirty arrays. The final example retains PR1295's B=(h+2)G and L=(h+2)^2 G, with N L a u<=1/2 checked separately, all inverse/restoration calls, coefficient preparation, inverse-preimage reserve and tape costs. Only the endpoint target factor N L is replaced by T(n)G.
success_evidence: All-size written endpoint inequality with explicit error support and negative-call premises; exact sharp count or explicit non-sharp status; registered CPython3.12 replay and semantic controls.
falsification: Any completed-endpoint leaf-destination response containing two free monomials or an operator amplification above the proposed subset bound falsifies the candidate lemma; source-error, early-cut and aliasing cases must be kept outside it.
